description: Use when an agent needs the real current time somewhere (models do not know "now"): returns the authoritative current UTC instant and, for each requested IANA time zone, the local date/time, weekday, UTC offset, abbreviation and whether daylight saving time is in effect. Computed from the IANA tz database, no upstream dependency. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
